summary: Badly-damaged abandoned vehicle reported on Slaughterhouse Gulch OHV trail; PCSAR teams searched and air-scent K9 found the unconscious, hypothermic driver ~0.4 mi downhill from the vehicle after ~45 min at scene; multiple lacerations, drifting in and out of consciousness; Flight for Life transported subject to hospital
location: Slaughterhouse Gulch OHV trail (Pine Junction area)
responding_agency: Park County SAR; Park County Sheriff; USFS; Flight for Life
notes: Exact date: Aug 30, 2020 call (Sunday); vehicle estimated abandoned late Sat night / early Sun. Driver remained hospitalized as of Tue Sep 1.
